children: GMX introduces a 180-day unstaking timelock on October 28, 2026, for staked GMX and esGMX on Arbitrum and Avalanche. The same waiting period applies to both tokens across the two networks.
The timelock delays access to tokens through unstaking. Holders cannot immediately withdraw the GMX or esGMX covered by the rule, so access to those staked balances is subject to the 180-day wait.
Two changes are planned for GMX on October 28:
🔹All remaining Solana-side revenue after GT buybacks will buy back GMX for the staking rewards pool
🔹 A 180-day unstaking timelock will be introduced for staked GMX and esGMX on Arbitrum and Avalanche

title: GMX: Introduces a 180-day unstaking lock for GMX and esGMX - 28 Oct 2026
